title: SELECTEDVALUE counts distinct values, not rows
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Product[Color], "Many" ), Product[Product] IN { "Bike", "Helmet" } ) )

source.quote: Returns the value when the context for columnName has been filtered down to one distinct value only.

derivation: Two Product rows are visible, Bike and Helmet, and both are Red: one distinct value of Product[Color], which is returned.
